same_topic_different_visual.note: Both cover water use by sector and both include Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Canada. Page 8 is a pie+bar mixed chart for three countries; page 42 is a table for four countries (adds New Zealand). Different visuals and different data - retained separately.

duplicate_analysis.method: SHA-256 over decoded RGB pixel buffers for all 50 pages, plus manual prompt review.
